assessments.topic: Owned native raw inputs and exact reference pin
assessments.finding: Native Uint8Array/Buffer slots are copied once using captured native getters/set. Proxy/subclass/shared buffers and empty/oversized inputs refuse. The primitive lowercase expected SHA is checked against the same owned reference bytes subsequently parsed; usage/settings original bytes have separate hashes/lengths/base64. Caller getters/iteration/toJSON are not part of the capture.

Fatal UTF8, paired Unicode, duplicate decoded keys, lexical/depth/node/array/string bounds, no trailing data, closed envelopes/usage fields and validated optional source metadata. Parsed dictionaries are null-prototype objects; explicit prototype-looking keys do not provide inherited facts.

Numbers are noncoercive and finite, magnitude<=MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, no negative zero. Raw decimal tokens must match the mathematical decimal identity of their JavaScript JSON re-emission. Accepted negative losses/zero/fractions and safe edges remain exact comparisons; rounding, underflow and excessive tokens refuse rather than alter the oracle.

Exact normalized CIK/taxonomy/concept/unit/start/end; strict calendar and UTC cutoff. Instant versus duration and quarter/YTD remain separate. Unit conversion, aliases and split derivations are absent. Unsupported taxonomy/unit/forms and missing company/concept/period produce explicit unknown outcomes.

Only strictly earlier periodic filing dates are eligible. Same-day filings override verdict to timing_indeterminate even when a prior diagnostic selection exists. Later vintages are diagnostic only, with no future-derived selection or trading-calendar/global first-availability inference.

Accession/order sorting is presentation only. Latest-date distinct accession/form/value identities remain ambiguous; exact identity duplicates can collapse without dropping visible originals. A uniquely later prior filing may resolve an older ambiguous date. No lexical accession chronology inference.

assessments.topic: Full selected-N and honest diagnostic claims
assessments.finding: Each usage row remains in the denominator with six status counts, supported/unknown verdict counts and explicit null-selection reasons. Later-only values/changed vintages are observations about this supplied snapshot. Formal restatement cause, global availability, rights/universe/survivorship/calibration/expert/split/strategy/indexing claims remain unestablished.

Fixed raw512KiB/usage64KiB/settings4KiB,32companies/64usage/2048source/4096combined returned vintages and parser ceilings. Aggregate includes supported and unsupported matched observations; no silent truncation or denominator shrink. Complete JSON report4MiB is checked before return, then every descendant is recursively frozen. Reviewer made no OOM/performance claim.

Whole-module SHA remains explicitly caller-declared and unverified by the pure core, including null when absent. Independent Git snapshot binds actual whole module40ac2b1e; functions/fixed policies/native assumptions and unchanged canonical functions have a separate behavior fingerprint. Recorded canonical dependency SHA matches independently read protected88119651 bytes. No claim of runtime self-file verification or authenticated caller declaration.

assessments.topic: Inert core and protected released/default behavior
assessments.finding: Only native crypto/util and existing root canonical helper are imported; no filesystem loader, callbacks, network/SDK, async provider, environment/home traversal, CLI, hosted/listed tool, server/version/schema/default instruction changes. Package change is focused registration plus insertion into existing verify; all other scripts/fields preserved.

assessments.topic: Useful documented example and meaningful fixtures
assessments.finding: Runnable synthetic import supplies four explicit native byte arguments and produces a prior100/later90 mismatch example.36 independently specified named cases include old-versus-future, ties in both orders, same-day, missing/fullN, units/quarterYTD, duplicate/raw tamper, type/getter/offset/immutability, numeric/calendar limits, exact byte/row/combined bounds, deterministic public JSON and the executable guide. Written source is reviewed; execution acceptance is in a separate retained-CI receipt.
